canonicality.additional_failure_explanation: Only the deliberately non-shortest CompactSize case changes; ordinary single-byte encodings and structured emission remain unchanged. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

bounds.additional_failure_explanation: Changing <= to < rejects reads that exactly exhaust the remaining bytes, including final locktime reads. Unknown optional flags still fail before that read, so those designated controls are unaffected. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

witness.additional_failure_explanation: The changed presence predicate requires more than one item. One-item witness and budget fixtures therefore become superfluous-witness errors; ordinary transactions and their identifiers do not use this predicate. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

consumed.additional_failure_explanation: Subtracting one from the successful cursor changes every successful decode consumption field, including zero-flags and prefix cases. Serialization and pre-success unknown-flag rejection do not use that return path. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

resource.additional_failure_explanation: Disabling the final item-budget comparison accepts both explicit-budget and default-budget complete oversized fixtures. Truncation still exits before the budget verdict; in-budget decodes are unchanged. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

hashing.additional_failure_explanation: The second SHA-256 hashes the original serialization again instead of the first digest. All identity and modified-structure identity cases change; byte-only parsing and serialization remain unaffected. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

structured.additional_failure_explanation: Writing zero instead of the supplied output amount changes serialization and identifiers of every nonzero-amount fixture. Decoding uses separate code, so its designated controls remain unaffected. No build error or crash is counted as a semantic kill.

byte_order.additional_failure_explanation: Removing digest-to-display reversal changes all identify outputs, including modified-structure identifiers. Decode and serialization-only results have no display-order field.

coverage.interpretation: Block reachability, not exhaustive edge/path coverage. Gaps retained; all authored executable symbols reached.
